raw_finding.practical_consequence: A fresh planner could omit a real projection path or fail to update and verify every repository-local directive consumer because the candidate collapses the topology to generic “AGENTS” surfaces and incorrectly says the projection writer owns only AGENTS fences.
evidence: Tasks/directive-system-vnext/research-v3/requirements.json (canonical hash ef4f614d7476fd40dc46af8aecfb4b3e9d9bbb7cfd2c0d92e5e4e3d51caa8548) requires every authoritative writer and generated consumer to be named for CUR-002.

Candidate 9eead8168503e378664f548002528e04c7f688764a76b4d02cf37a7df8043d36 states that generate_projections.py owns only generated AGENTS fences and records the consumer merely as “AGENTS”; it does not enumerate the concrete trusted-and-allowlisted target surfaces.

working-agreement/generate_projections.py (evidence P, sha256 3f186dac72da0045cc40b368c16eb55850de429aae03f3903ece7644c2eca6b6) implements both agents and claude-pointer render paths and derives refresh targets from the intersection of Codex trusted projects and codex-projects.allowlist.

working-agreement/codex-projects.allowlist (evidence AL, sha256 c9536c232af4eb071a7dc56c79ce78a65efd22aa40264ae0fc611d01fd2518ea) and /Users/kamenkamenov/.codex/config.toml (evidence CFG, frozen sha256 414a006b5df214cfa64dc7820755d3aa1aca538a327d03a2f97830c9632d9cfc) establish the finite concrete target set, while tests/test_generate_projections.py (evidence TGP, sha256 44e5f1c8426185fa7e151ee87530d4cf7ef731f9c4038d88ca47faab79c0d7cb) explicitly validates the claude-pointer projection path.

raw_finding.practical_consequence: Rollback could report success while a forward-only directive identity remains active, so the proposed adoption contract cannot yet prove that the prior corpus state was restored exactly.
evidence: The frozen FUT-009 acceptance intent requires a finite rollback condition across the corpus boundary, and candidate-round-2 strengthens this to active-only read-back proving every prior identity active and every forward-only identity absent.
working-agreement/sync_corpus.py:107-115 performs that check through corpus_query with limit=5 and decides presence by searching title and slug in the semantic-search response.

src/memory_knowledge/workflows/corpus.py:198-232 and src/memory_knowledge/server.py:497-505 establish that corpus_query is similarity-ranked semantic search with a bounded top-k result, not an exact identity lookup. Because corpus identity permits multiple titles for one link_slug, a bounded semantic result cannot prove that a particular identity is absent.

tests/test_sync_corpus.py only checks that corpus_query is called and that deactivation follows successful upserts; tests/test_corpus.py verifies filtering/ranking behavior but contains no exact-identity absence proof or renamed-forward-identity rollback test.
raw_finding.evidence_limitation: The inspected sources prove the verification route is non-exact; they do not establish whether deployed data currently contains enough same-slug identities to trigger a false-success case.
